subject: Cyber Physical Systems Security
text: A smart grid CPS monitors power consumption in a residential area. The system records usage in kWh and must detect anomalies that might indicate theft or malfunction. Given the following hourly readings for a house: {2.3, 2.5, 8.9, 2.4, 2.6, 2.2} kWh. Calculate the mean and standard deviation of given consumption. Using 2σ rule, identify any anomalous readings.
